name: iumrah-beta-update-20260912-restore-pre-apple-store-ui-v1
purpose: Restore the exact user interface source that existed before the Apple Store redesign work.
notes: All previously existing UI files touched by Apple Store redesign passes are restored byte-for-byte from the pre-redesign repository snapshot.
Apple-only source files that did not exist in that snapshot are replaced with empty Swift files because the repository ZIP patch workflow cannot delete files.
New Apple-only image assets may remain physically in the asset catalog after rollback but are not referenced by the restored pre-redesign UI.
